title: Prelaunch Prioritization Matrix & Runway Journal
body:
Purpose:
This doc is a lightweight working journal for the upcoming feature activation (internal name: Aurora Preview). It combines a pragmatic prioritization matrix, a short runway / resource forecast, and a compact KPI tracker we can iterate during the next 8 weeks. Intended audience: product ops, release engineer lead, solutions engineering oncall, and assigned owners for launch tasks.

Context / constraints:
- Feature: Aurora Preview (rolled out to beta customers, will be gated by Dedicated slots and API quota).
- Target internal date window: phased rollout starting 2026-03-15 canary, 2026-04-05 gradual open beta.
- Capacity constraints: Dedicated pool alpha has 40% of projected Q2 concurrency; autoscale configured but with 3–6 minute warm up for new nodes.
- SLAs: latency p50 target unchanged; p95 must not degrade more than 20% from baseline for production traffic profile.
- Business success signal: early retention (week-1 active) and cost per 1k tokens under threshold for profitability pilot.

Runway snapshot (8-week view):
Week 0 (2026-02-24): baseline metrics collected for current model serving; canary prompts and eval sets finalized.
Week 2 (2026-03-09): end of internal smoke; Dedicated capacity ramp plan approved.
Week 3 (2026-03-15): canary begins (1% of beta customers); telemetry hooks active.
Week 4–6 (2026-03-22 to 2026-04-12): phased increase to 25% -> 60% -> 100% beta traffic.
Week 8 (2026-04-28): post-rollout stabilization and initial KPI readout.

Prioritization matrix (working):
- How to read: score 1–5 per axis (Impact, Cost/Risk to Infra, Dependence on cross-team work). Higher total = higher priority.

ASCII table:
Task | Impact | Infra Risk | Cross-team | Notes
-----|--------|-----------|------------|------
A. Autoscaler policy tweak & burst budget | 5 | 4 | 3 | Reduce warm-up impact for sudden traffic spikes
B. Prefetch & prefix-KV cache rules update | 4 | 3 | 2 | Critical for typical chat flows
C. Canary error handling fallback (model variant) | 5 | 2 | 4 | Protect latency SLO when quantized model misbehaves
D. Billing metric flag & metering labels | 3 | 1 | 2 | Enables per-customer profitability tracking
E. Docs + partner beta onboarding kit | 2 | 1 | 5 | Sales/CS dependency but low infra cost
F. Regression eval set (prompt corpus) | 5 | 1 | 1 | Must be final before canary

Quick calc (sum of scores) -> sort for sprint allocation: F, C, A, B, D, E (working ordering; adjust per owner input).

Compact KPI tracker (to update weekly) format:
- Metric: baseline -> current -> target by week8
- MAU for beta cohort: 0 -> 120 active -> 800+ (target for pilot)
- Week-1 retention (beta): 0% -> 32% -> target 40%
- Cost per 1k tokens (hosted/dedicated split): $8.40 -> $7.20 -> target <$6.50
- P95 latency change vs baseline: 0% -> +12% -> target < +20%
- Error rate (5xx + model-failure): 0.18% -> 0.25% -> target < 0.5%

Action checklist (owner / current status / notes):
- Autoscaler policy tweak (owner: Carlos Mendes) — in_progress — PR #214 opened; needs SRE signoff; simulate spike 50k rps test.
- Prefetch / KV cache rules (owner: Priya Nair) — ready_for_test — staging instrumentation added; verify cache hit rate > 85%.
- Canary fallback rules (owner: Evelyn Zhao) — blocked (awaiting variant policy doc) — draft in GH link; timeline slippage risk if not resolved in 3 days.
- Billing flags and metering labels (owner: Jordan Park) — todo — needs product input on label taxonomy.
- Beta onboarding kit (owner: Customer Success: Mateo Lopez) — drafting — initial deck and sample integration flows in progress.
- Regression eval set (owner: Data & Eval: Anya S.) — done — canonical prompt set v1 uploaded to S3 (s3://redwood-prodops/aurora/evals/v1).

Risk heatmap (short notes):
- Capacity mismatch: Medium-High — autoscale warm-up and pod cold-start causing transient 2x latency spikes. Mitigation: pre-warm pool for first 30 minutes of each traffic window; reserve burst budget (see task A).
- Regression to quality due to quantization: Medium — have fallback policy and rapid rollback steps; ensure evals catch quality regressions on key prompts.
- Billing surprise (customers exceed pilot quota): Low-Medium — add enforcement + notification; billing flags task prioritized.
- Cross-team blockage (GTM onboarding): Medium — CS and Sales must provide onboarding resources by Week 2 or schedule will slip.

Decision log (rolling):
- 2026-02-25: Agreed to hard-gate canary on regression eval pass + autoscaler pre-warm configured. (Owner: Jordan Park)
- 2026-03-01: Approve temporary burst budget of 150% for first two weeks of canary. (Owner: Finance & Infra lead)
- 2026-03-08: If P95 degradation exceeds +20% on two consecutive days, immediate 50% traffic rollback and activation of fallback model variant. (Owner: Release comms + SRE)

Monitoring dashboard suggestions (quick links to ask SRE):
- Token cost heatmap by customer label (daily)
- P95 latency trend by model variant and region (1m/5m/1h)
- Cache hit ratio and KV eviction rate (5m)
- Canary-specific alerts: new error spike > 0.3% or latency breach > +20% for 10m

Open questions / TODOs (for next sync):
1) Confirm exact label taxonomy for metering and billing (Jordan to confirm with finance).
2) Finalize fallback model variant name and acceptance criteria (Evelyn + Serving runtime).
3) Run two gated load tests covering warm-path and cold-path (Carlos to schedule with infra).
4) CS to publish Beta integration guide v0.1 and coordinate 3 pilot customers for canary.

Notes to reviewers:
- This is intentionally concise; use this doc as a staging area for two weeks. Add short timestamped updates below (append-only). After rollout we’ll convert the final state into a launch-readout artifact for leadership.

Append-only log (sample entries):
- [2026-02-26 Jordan] Autoscaler PR opened, test harness awaiting infra creds.
- [2026-02-27 Priya] Staging cache hit rate at 81% on chat-sim workload; optimizing rules now.
- [2026-03-02 Carlos] Spike sim scheduled 2026-03-04 02:00 PT, will run step up to 60k rps for 10 minutes.

End of doc.

(If you want a sheet formatted version of the KPI tracker for weekly updates I can spin a simple Google Sheet template with the same fields and weekly rows — lmk and I will create and link it here.)
